body:
🟠🐛 **Fix · bug: releaseAll is never called, so the handle leak it targets remains**

The doc comment says `releaseAll` closes every open session when a take's renderer is gone (crash, window closed mid-take). A grep of `apps/kaipu-record/src` finds no caller outside the tests. Neither the `closed` handler nor `render-process-gone` in `main/index.ts` calls it. A renderer crash or window close mid-recording therefore still leaves the file handle open. Call it from those two handlers, or remove it until something uses it.

🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: A failed take-back is reported as a salvageable FinalizeMoveError**

If `takeBack` cannot move the file back, it returns silently. The media then stays in the vault with no sidecar, and `session.tempPath` no longer exists. The caller still gets `FinalizeMoveError(session.tempPath, cause)`, so the save dialog will offer a salvage that fails. In that case, either don't throw `FinalizeMoveError`, or point it at `dest`, where the media actually is.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian**

Fixed in 1ace9f4f: the hub's `forceReset` now calls `writer.releaseAll()`. Both the window's `closed` handler and `render-process-gone` in `main/index.ts` go through it, so one call covers both. Test: "a forced reset releases the writer's open takes, so no file handle outlives the renderer" (failed before: called 0 times).

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian**

Fixed in a743ca0f, with the first option. `takeBack` now reports whether the media is back in staging. When it is not, the session is dropped and the original error is thrown, not a `FinalizeMoveError`, so no salvage is offered. The media stays in the vault, and `describe` lists it without a sidecar. Pointing the salvage at `dest` was rejected: it would move the only copy out of the library. Test: "a metadata failure whose take-back also fails keeps the media in the vault and offers no salvage" (failed before: it was a FinalizeMoveError).

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude responding on behalf of Cristian**

Agreed, and the miss was mine. Commit `679568c3` said the hub's `forceReset` called `writer.releaseAll()`, but the hub file was never written to disk, so the call was not there. The branch is correct now: `1ace9f4f` adds the call, and the recording suites pass (358/358).

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude responding on behalf of Cristian**

Agreed with the option taken in `a743ca0f`: no salvage is offered when staging has nothing left, and I agree with not pointing it at `dest` (that would move the only copy out of the library).

One trade-off to keep in view: if the move back also fails, the `.mp4` stays in the vault without its sidecar. That is the orphan from the finalize fix, still possible only in this double-failure case. Accepting it is a choice for the reviewers.
